_note: TEMPLATE for the COMBINED O1 + Foundation Learner session. Every value beginning with UNRESOLVED must be bound by the operator before a real run; campaign/session_supervisor.py and deploy/fl_b200_entry.sh both REFUSE a non-rehearsal session that still carries one. See deploy/INTEGRATION.md section 4.
session_id: UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_BOUND (a unique id for this session)
label: FL_B200_SESSION
o1_hash_manifests: UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_BOUND (O1's own manifests, e.g. /outputs/records.jsonl.sha256 or a TRANSFER_MANIFEST.json)
o1_transfer_command: UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_BOUND (the O1 result upload; FL only runs it and checks the return code)
fl_pregen_source: UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_BOUND (hf://<ns>/<repo>[/<prefix>] holding artifacts_fl/pregen; the ~480 MB episode corpus is neither in Git nor in the container image, so deploy/fl_b200_entry.sh materialises it with campaign/fetch_pregen.py and re-hashes every shard against MANIFESTS/SHARD_SUMS.json before the ladder starts. Leave unset only when pregen_root is already mounted.)
session_authorized_seconds: UNRESOLVED_SESSION_TIME (authorized runtime for the WHOLE session; FL receives what remains after O1 closes)
fl_transfer_command: UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_BOUND (upload FL_ARTIFACTS.zip to the FL results repository — SEPARATE from the O1 results repository)
terminate_command: UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_BOUND (terminate — never merely stop — the accelerator)
_fl_entry_note: The fields below are consumed by campaign/entry.py, which builds the real StageContext (contract 13/22, Amendment 12). They are OPTIONAL and have campaign defaults; fl_tiny_model, fl_eval_episode_cap and fl_train_example_cap are REFUSED unless rehearsal=true, because they substitute the nonscientific model or shorten the frozen per-stage evaluation maxima.
_o1_entry_note: RESOLVED during the B300 migration: the O1 pod-side entry is the real production zero-touch entry (start_b300.sh -> o1_b200.runner.production_entry); the historical refusing-stub gap is closed. The operator may still override the command in the session config.
fl_durable_destination: UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_BOUND (durable mirror root for the FL journal + training checkpoints under INTERRUPTIBLE capacity, e.g. hf://<ns>/<repo>/fl or a mounted path; restore-on-start + continuous push; see campaign/durability.py)
_preemption_note: INTERRUPTIBLE capacity: on eviction the provider layer terminates the remnant and reacquires a qualifying accelerator (B300 primary, B200 explicit fallback); the supervisor journal and every atomic training checkpoint mirror continuously to fl_durable_destination, and a fresh pod resumes from the last valid atomic checkpoint with identical hyperparameters (arm_config_hash-bound). Work after the last durable checkpoint reruns.
